name: Kishitani Yoshio
source:
Advisor of the school's swimming club.
He has the oiliness that is typical of an older man, and the lewdness that oozes from his whole being makes his very existence to be a sexual harassment.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
